title: What Should SFT Learn? Conditional Information Gain for Generalizable Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.12995v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) remains a widely used approach for post-training large language models, because fixed demonstrations can directly introduce desired reasoning strategies and behavioral patterns. Yet forcing a model to imitate externally provided trajectories may also interfere with behaviors already supported by pretraining, limiting generalization beyond the training distribution. Recent dynamic SFT methods mitigate this issue by reweighting token-level supervision according to model-side signals such as predictive probability, prior support, or distributional compatibility. However, model compatibility is not equivalent to learning value: a token that is weakly supported by the current model may either be an undesirable mismatch or precisely the task-specific decision that the demonstration is intended to teach. We propose CIG-SFT, an information-theoretic framework that estimates the task-conditioned information carried

translated_title: SFT应该学习什么？用于可泛化后训练的条件信息增益
translated_abstract: 监督微调（SFT）仍然是大语言模型后训练中广泛使用的方法，因为固定的示范可以直接引入期望的推理策略和行为模式。然而，强迫模型模仿外部提供的轨迹也可能干扰预训练已经支持的行为，从而限制模型在训练分布之外的泛化能力。近期的动态SFT方法通过根据模型侧信号（如预测概率、先验支持度或分布兼容性）对词元级监督进行重新加权来缓解这一问题。然而，模型兼容性并不等同于学习价值：一个当前模型支持度较弱的词元，可能是不希望出现的不匹配，也可能恰恰是示范意图教授的任务特定决策。我们提出CIG-SFT，这是一个信息论框架，用于估计任务条件下的信息量……
tldr: 提出CIG-SFT信息论框架，用条件信息增益而非模型兼容性来决定SFT应学习哪些词元，从而提升大语言模型后训练的泛化能力。
